source_note: Duma & Benaharon, 'Efficient Frontier Optimization of NBA Shot Selection Using Markov Reward Processes', arXiv:2607.02933v1 [stat.AP], 3 Jul 2026 (Nirek Duma, Leo Benaharon), 20 pages. Models NBA shot selection as a dynamic portfolio: possession-level absorbing Markov reward process (18-state space; fundamental matrix N=(I-Q)^-1) + mean-variance shot allocation over rim/midrange/corner-three/non-corner-three + ridge-fitted timeout-response stability cost. Transient value VT=e_PS^T N(pi)r (continuation-inclusive) vs one-step V1; rim misses highest offensive-rebound continuation (0.384 vs ~0.26 threes); covariance portfolio variance (co-moving families); objective max normalized V - lambda1*variance - lambda2*response, dx/dy-tail knee rule, SLSQP. No-fastbreak optimization (geometry unobserved; removed 129,695 FB possessions) + fixed observed fastbreak recomposition (alphaL=0.105). Findings: all franchises near league efficient frontier; marginal reduce perimeter+midrange/increase rim; EV-only overstates perimeter; 3pt revolution slightly past optimal boundary; calibration 1.149 PPP ~ empirical 1.15; no universal diet (team-conditional); shrinkage fixes Washington small-sample noise but penalizes Denver's true efficient extreme. Refines Fichman-O'Brien MPT (predicted 38% 3pt equilibrium, now 41.5%; non-transient gap). Limitations: make% held constant (attempts not randomly assigned -> endogeneity), macro not granular (no personnel identification), fastbreaks excluded, defense only implicit; future expected-points->expected-wins. Data NBA live PBP 2021-22..2025-26. Extracted faithfully (not a derivative summary). Equations (fundamental matrix, diet row logic, V1/VT, covariance/portfolio variance, ridge response + cost, objective/normalization, knee rule, hybrid, shrinkage) printed in math font that extracts garbled; reconstructed in labeled LaTeX and flagged here and in assumptions. Domain math matches catalog (basketball analytics / stochastic portfolio optimization; not football). Directly isomorphic to GSE's drive-expectancy MRP kernel (same as Goldner 2012), continuation-inclusive EP, diversification-aware risk, opponent-adjustment veto, frontier selection, partial-observability handling, and small-sample-shrinkage caution. No sportsbook lines/spreads/totals/implied odds in source or lifted into GSE.

primitives.name: dx/dy-tail knee rule: select frontier point where risk added faster than value

assumptions: The main knee rule is the dx/dy-tail rule: order the upper efficient envelope as (xm,ym)=(sigma^2(pi_m),V(pi_m)), compute the local tail slope |dx/dy|_m ~ |(x_{m+1}-x_m)/(y_{m+1}-y_m)|, and select the high-value frontier point where this quantity is smallest — the part of the frontier where the curve has entered its nearly vertical tail, more risk being added faster than useful value; it is used as the main rule because it is conservative and matches risk-controlled shot allocation. reasoning_traces.think: The retrocausal genealogy of this paper is the fusion of micro possession modeling with macro portfolio theory for basketball shot selection. Nirek Duma and Leo Benaharon, posting to arXiv in July 2026 as 2607.02933, ask whether modern NBA shot selection can be evaluated as a dynamic portfolio problem rather than a collection of isolated shot attempts. The work sits in the lineage of Skinner's optimal-stopping shot-selection model, Sandholtz and Bornn's Markov decision processes with dynamic transition probabilities, Cervone, D'Amour, Bornn, and Goldsberry's multiresolution stochastic possession model, and Pelechrinis and Goldsberry's anatomy of corner threes, while directly refining Fichman and O'Brien's Modern Portfolio Theory application to basketball, which predicted a three-point equilibrium near thirty-eight percent of field-goal attempts that the league reached in 2019 and has since pushed past to forty-one and a half percent. The gap the paper fills is that Fichman and O'Brien treated shot diets as non-transient, ignoring rebound continuations. The recursive theory of mind is the absorbing Markov reward process and its portfolio objective. Each possession maps into an eighteen-state space splitting made and missed shots by location and result and offensive rebounds by the type of miss that created them, with an absorbing end-of-possession state; removing that state leaves a transient block whose fundamental matrix N equals the inverse of I minus Q and counts expected visits before absorption. A candidate shot diet over rim, midrange, corner three, and non-corner three reallocates shot-outcome mass in the possession-start and offensive-rebound rows while preserving non-shot, free-throw, and possession-ending mass and the category make rates, so the transient value, the possession-start row of N times the reward vector, becomes the return term; it exceeds the one-step first-shot value precisely because it includes continuation after offensive rebounds, where rim misses create the most continuation at roughly zero point three eight four versus about zero point two six for threes. Cross-layer veto adjudication is the risk-and-response-augmented frontier and its empirical verdict. The objective maximizes normalized transient value minus a variance penalty and a timeout-response penalty, where portfolio variance uses the full game-level covariance because shot families co-move and diversification matters, and the response cost is the squared norm of a ridge-fitted timeout response matrix acting on the diet's pressure vector, an implicit coaching adjustment cost capturing the defense's tendency to regress an unsustainable advantage back toward the mean after a timeout. A grid search over the two penalty weights traces the frontier and a conservative dx/dy-tail knee rule selects the point where the curve enters its nearly vertical tail, adding risk faster than value. The verdict is that all NBA franchises already live close to the league efficient frontier, with only marginal gains from slightly reducing perimeter and midrange volume in favor of rim attempts, so the three-point revolution has pushed volume slightly past its optimal boundary and optimizing solely for expected value mathematically overstates the benefit of perimeter shots. The implementation invariants map directly onto GSE. The absorbing Markov reward process and its fundamental matrix are GSE's drive-expectancy kernel, the same structure as the Goldner 2012 Markov drive model already in the corpus; the transient-versus-one-step value is GSE's continuation-inclusive expected points over immediate expected points; the covariance-based portfolio variance is GSE's diversification-aware risk kernel; and the timeout-response cost is GSE's opponent-adjustment and structural-stability veto. The min-max normalization before the objective is GSE's comparable-scales discipline, the no-fastbreak optimization with fixed observed recomposition is GSE's partial-observability handling, and the points-per-possession calibration check, where the model's one point one four nine aligns with the empirical league one point one five, is GSE's scale-alignment verification. The outputs are shot-diet recommendations from play-by-play data; GSE lifts no sportsbook lines, spreads, totals, or implied odds. The team-level and shrinkage results make the conditional-optimality point concrete and honest. There is no single universally optimal shot diet because teams differ in shot efficiency, rebounding paths, covariance structure, and transition tendencies, yet the divergence between team-specific optima is narrower than the stark stylistic contrasts of the modern league, since Denver and Boston maintain elite efficiency with opposite perimeter philosophies. The shrinkage sensitivity exposes a fundamental limitation: an empirical-Bayes estimator that shrinks team rows toward the league with a thousand pseudo-counts correctly regresses Washington's small-sample noise, whose optimum was an almost-all-rim anomaly, but inappropriately penalizes Denver's statistically extreme yet highly efficient structural reality, introducing severe volatility into Denver's optimum, so the main analysis keeps the empirical team matrices and treats shrinkage as a sensitivity check. The caveats close the account with the scope and endogeneity limits that bound the prescription. The model deliberately holds make percentages constant when shot shares change because attempts are not randomly assigned — a team may shoot more from a category because it is hot, because the defense concedes it, or because personnel created good looks — so regressing attempts on shooting percentage would be flawed and optical tracking is needed to estimate efficiency versus frequency; the framework is a macro-level prescription rather than a granular franchise tool because it lacks personnel identification, superstar gravity, lineup spacing, and matchup pressure; fastbreaks are excluded because their geometry is unobserved; and defense is only implicit through the timeout response. The invariant for GSE is to carry the Markov-reward portfolio valuation, the continuation-inclusive transient value, the covariance-and-response risk penalties, the conservative frontier knee rule, and the partial-observability recomposition while recording the fixed-make-rate endogeneity caution, the shrinkage noise-versus-true-extreme asymmetry, and the future objective of mapping shot portfolios from expected points to expected win probability, treating the near-frontier empirical finding as evidence that elaborate variance-aware optimization yields only marginal gains over already-optimized league behavior.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: Fuse micro possession modeling with macro portfolio theory for NBA shot selection. Nirek Duma, Leo Benaharon; arXiv:2607.02933v1 [stat.AP] 3 Jul 2026. Lineage: Skinner 2011 optimal stopping, Sandholtz-Bornn 2020 AOAS MDP dynamic transitions, Cervone-D'Amour-Bornn-Goldsberry 2016 JASA multiresolution possession, Pelechrinis-Goldsberry 2021 corner-3 anatomy; refines Fichman-O'Brien 2018 J Sports Analytics / 2019 JQAS Modern Portfolio Theory (predicted 3pt equilibrium ~38% FGA, reached 2019, now 41.5%; treated diets non-transient). Gap: add rebound continuation. Moreyball (Daryl Morey rim+arc); 2018 Rockets 27 straight missed threes Game 7 WCF downside exemplar.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Possession = absorbing MRP; 18-state space (PS, made/missed by location R/M/C3/NC3, FT1-3, OR by miss type, EP absorbing). P_ij=Pr(Xt+1=j|Xt=i); Q transient block; N=(I-Q)^-1=I+Q+Q^2+... (expected visits). Diet pi=(piR,piM,piC3,piNC3) sum=1; P(pi) reallocates PS+OR shot mass preserving non-shot/FT/EP + make rates; Pr(row->zM)=omega*pi_z*pz. Reward rRM=rMM=2/rC3M=rNC3M=3; V1=e_PS^T Q(pi)r (one-step); VT=e_PS^T N(pi)r (transient, main, includes continuation). Rim misses highest OR continuation (0.384 vs ~0.26 threes). Variance sigma^2(pi)=pi^T Sigma pi (game-level covariance, co-moving families). Timeout response ridge B^T=(X^T X+alpha I)^-1 X^T Y; E(pi)=||B s(pi)||^2 (implicit coaching cost). Objective max Vtilde-lambda1 sigma^2tilde-lambda2 Etilde (min-max normalized); grid search + SLSQP; dx/dy-tail knee rule. Hybrid pi=(1-alpha)piNF*+alpha rhoFB (alphaL=0.105). Shrinkage P=(n+K Pleague)/(N+K), K=1000. Equations math-font reconstructed.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: EV-only overstates perimeter; all franchises near league efficient frontier (already optimized); marginal reduce 3pt+midrange/increase rim; no-FB transient optimum 0.415/0.233/0.095/0.257 (diversified). Response-cost min ~ actual league diet (~L2) but B asymmetric (cross-correlated); negative diagonal mean reversion. Calibration 1.149 PPP ~ empirical 1.15. No universal diet (Denver/Boston opposite philosophies both elite); optimality conditional on ecosystem+personnel. Shrinkage fixes Washington small-sample noise (all-rim anomaly) but penalizes Denver true efficient extreme (destabilizes) -> empirical main, shrinkage sensitivity (K=0 vs 1000 max L1 0.8575/0.9545). Make% held constant (attempts not random: hot/defense/personnel -> endogeneity); macro not granular (no personnel/gravity/spacing); fastbreaks excluded (geometry unobserved); defense only implicit (timeout). Future: expected points -> expected win probability (game-state simulators). Data NBA PBP 2021-22..2025-26; no-FB removed 129695 FB possessions. Zero sportsbook lines lifted.

universal_lens: A dynamic-portfolio treatment of NBA shot selection models each possession as an absorbing Markov reward process whose fundamental matrix yields a continuation-inclusive transient value, then optimizes a rim/midrange/corner-three/non-corner-three shot diet against normalized transient value minus a covariance-based variance penalty and a ridge-fitted timeout-response stability cost, selecting a conservative efficient-frontier knee; the result is that all NBA franchises already operate near the league frontier with only marginal gains from shifting volume toward rim attempts, demonstrating that optimizing solely for expected value overstates perimeter shots, that no universal shot diet exists, and that shrinkage can correctly regress small-sample noise while inappropriately penalizing a genuinely efficient extreme.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats possession absorbing MRP (18 states; N=(I-Q)^-1 expected visits); diet pi over R/M/C3/NC3 (sum=1) reallocates PS+OR shot mass preserving non-shot/FT/EP + make rates (Pr(row->zM)=omega*pi_z*pz); reward 2/2/3/3; V1=e_PS^T Q(pi)r vs VT=e_PS^T N(pi)r (continuation main); rim misses highest OR continuation (no-FB 0.384/0.270/0.258/0.260); covariance sigma^2(pi)=pi^T Sigma pi (co-moving families); timeout ridge B^T=(X^T X+alpha I)^-1 X^T Y, E(pi)=||B s(pi)||^2 (implicit coaching cost, defense regresses to mean); objective max Vtilde-lambda1 var-lambda2 E (min-max normalized), grid+SLSQP, dx/dy-tail knee; no-FB diet 0.313/0.277/0.105/0.305 (removed 129695 FB), full 0.345/0.252/0.103/0.301; hybrid pi=(1-alpha)piNF*+alpha rhoFB (alphaL=0.105, rhoFB 0.571/0.070/0.090/0.269); all franchises near frontier, no-FB transient optimum 0.415/0.233/0.095/0.257; response min ~ actual (~L2) but B asymmetric; calibration 1.149 PPP~1.15; no universal diet (Denver/Boston); shrinkage P=(n+K Pleague)/(N+K) K=1000 fixes Washington noise/penalizes Denver extreme (max L1 0.8575/0.9545); make% constant (attempts not random endogeneity); macro not granular; fastbreaks excluded; defense implicit; future points->wins; refines Fichman-O'Brien (38%->41.5%, non-transient); equations math-font reconstructed.
gse_mapping: GSE lifts the absorbing-MRP drive-expectancy kernel and fundamental matrix (same as Goldner 2012), the continuation-inclusive transient value over one-step EP, the covariance-based diversification-aware portfolio variance, the ridge timeout-response cost as its opponent-adjustment/structural-stability veto, the min-max-normalized multi-objective with conservative dx/dy-tail frontier knee, the no-fastbreak-plus-fixed-recomposition partial-observability handling, and the PPP scale-alibration check; treats the fixed-make-rate endogeneity caution (attempts not randomly assigned), the shrinkage noise-versus-true-extreme asymmetry (Washington vs Denver), the macro-not-granular personnel scope, and the implicit-defense limitation as honest bounds, and the expected-points-to-expected-wins objective shift as its valuation goal; all outputs are shot-diet recommendations from play-by-play data, never sportsbook lines, and the near-frontier finding shows variance-aware optimization yields only marginal gains over already-optimized league behavior.
